findings.message: The field "Email Address:" asks for the user's email address but does not identify that purpose: autocomplete="email" is missing. Chromium's own form check flags this field too.

patch.before: <input class="newsletter-signup__input svelte-m7l5d3" type="email" placeholder="Your email address" id="newsletter-signup-email-1" name="email" required="">
patch.after: <input class="newsletter-signup__input svelte-m7l5d3" type="email" placeholder="Your email address" id="newsletter-signup-email-1" name="email" required="" autocomplete="email">

findings.message: The field "Please enter your email address:" asks for the user's email address but does not identify that purpose: autocomplete="email" is missing. Chromium's own form check flags this field too.

patch.before: <input type="email" name="email" id="bottom-panel-cta-email" class="bottom-panel-cta__email svelte-1dz4e5r" placeholder="you@example.com" required="">
patch.after: <input type="email" name="email" id="bottom-panel-cta-email" class="bottom-panel-cta__email svelte-1dz4e5r" placeholder="you@example.com" required="" autocomplete="email">
